# Kavelo — Software Development Agency

> Kavelo is a senior engineering software development agency that builds high-performance websites, custom web applications, and mobile applications for founders and ambitious teams.

## Core Capabilities
- **Websites & Landing Pages**: Built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript. Optimized for conversion, ultra-fast load times, and SEO.
- **Custom Platforms & Portals**: Scalable SaaS platforms, web applications, and internal tools built with Next.js, Node.js, and cloud backends.
- **Mobile Applications**: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps using React Native.

## Values & Approach
- **Ship, Don't Stall**: Fast delivery, momentum, and short iterations.
- **Technical Honesty**: Direct answers, realistic commitments, and transparent engineering advice.
- **Senior Engineers Only**: Direct access to senior builders — no junior handoffs or project manager layers.
